summary: Operator site + its Park With Us engine: confirmed $38 base (June 2027, 23-ft rig), phone, presence. Changed fees high 38 -> 50 (premium 50-ft sites); added 30/50-amp full hookups, pull-throughs, max 50 ft, showers/laundry/dump, booking URL. Not stated: site count (engine lists only free sites), season. Note: dropped the price and RV Life restatements.
flags: Price gate: base $38 (standard sites) under US$50; premium $50. No gateway within 40 km (Black Canyon 85 km). Family has not stayed here.

Long-stay character: the About page says 'Stay a day or stay forever ... we are thrilled to welcome our hard working locals, and our free spirited adventurists alike' - some long-term/worker occupancy likely, but nightly rates are posted and sold online, so test 2 passes; test 4 (share sold nightly) not determinable.
Presence: working website with phone 970-865-2101, booking engine, Google Maps 4.3 / 73 reviews. Open now (engine sells October-November 2026 nights).
